commits.subject: v12: KV page layout without allocator padding (1,531,258 tokens), NVFP4 KV tried
README: clean 2400 MHz measurement of v12, SSD offload live result, T=0 reproducibility note
v22: patches 0062-0074, background only in idle time, Zig comparison
SSD KV offload in use (0056/0058), serve example updated
512K context by default (needle at 479K 3/3), serve example
SSD KV offload off again: rank 1 read stale blocks across two nodes
v24: KV offload across two nodes (0077/0081), 1M context, replay skip, Engram lookahead

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Target indexer defer; use K1 composition, no second mount.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0051 | the indexer's `weights_proj` GEMV (hidden → 32 heads, 56–61 µs on GB10) no longer makes the main stream wait right after the fused QKV GEMM: the join moves to the first read, and with short contexts, where every candidate is selected and the weights are never read, the GEMV is skipped (`VLLM_DSV41_INDEXER_DEFER=1`); bit-identical | **in use** since 21.10., measured together with the RDMA ring over both PCIe functions (cost per round −1.20 %, step 1 of "From v12 to v22"); on top of 0054 alone it measured +0.2 % (within noise) |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Display KV code carried by K1; switch stays off, slower reads and less headroom.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0053 | KV cache backed by the GB10 display reservation (1,792 MiB per node, DRM dumb buffer + `cuMemHostRegister`) with pinned ordinary memory behind it (`VLLM_DSV41_DISPLAY_KV_MIB`) | off: KV pool +47 %, but ~1 GB less free memory under load and +1.5 % per round (see "Tried") |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Display embedding/Markov allocation regressed; Markov is remote and embedding move conflicts with capacity accounting.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0054 | token embedding (631 MiB per rank) and the DSpark Markov cache (505 MiB) in the display reservation, copied bit-exact (`VLLM_DSV41_DISPLAY_TENSORS=1`) | off: decode −1.7 % (geometric mean), 64K code −6.7 % |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Hybrid local drafter probability/state path is absent in capacity mode; remote contract is greedy. Also failed upstream prose gate.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0055 | draft mode per request from the 0047 regime: requests that plan the full window draft probabilistically, the others greedy with a one-hot draft distribution, so their verification stays exact (`VLLM_DSV41_HYBRID_DRAFT=1`) | off: +0.75 % at T=1 (code at 1 stream +5.0 %), but prose at 1 stream −1.6 % |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: CRC protects files, not rank mismatch; retain RP1 safety gates.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0056 | CRC-32 sidecar for every block of vLLM's file-system KV offload tier, checked after each load; a bad block is deleted and recomputed (`VLLM_DSV41_KV_CRC=1`) | **in use again** since 22.10. with image v24, together with 0058, 0077 and 0081. Off 02:08–21:40 that day: with TP across two nodes vLLM's tiering spec kept rank 1's pages on a node nothing reads them back from, so a load from disk gave rank 1 stale blocks (garbage text, NaN logits, an illegal memory access); 0077 fixes that. The CRC cannot see such a case, the bytes on disk are fine; it guards the files themselves. |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: FP8 page pairing; preserve K1 record/group layout.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0057 | paired KV pages: the ratio-1 compressed-KV group takes 128-token blocks made of two 64-state kernel pages and stops paying the ratio-2 group's block stride (`VLLM_DSV41_KV_PAIR=1`; `VLLM_DSV41_KV_SWA_FILL=1` fills the sliding-window groups up to the stride) | KV pool 989,460 → 1,346,928 tokens (+36 %), live 3,267 → 2,187 B per token, cost per round −0.3 %, T=0 identical 8/8, corruption test 0 hits |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Connector-specific allocator exception, not a general allocator change.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0058 | vLLM's OffloadingConnector next to `expandable_segments:True` (`VLLM_DSV41_OFFLOAD_EXPANDABLE_OK=1`) | needed for 0056; in use with it |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: NVFP4 code dependency carried by K1; NEVER enable, distribution regression.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0059 | NVFP4 KV records on GB10: FlashInfer's 384 B SM120 record (e2m1 with an e4m3 scale per 16, RoPE in BF16) for the window and the compressed KV, written with FlashInfer's own quantize-append; SWA indices padded to 512 for DSpark's 192-wide non-causal verify (`VLLM_DSV41_KV_NVFP4=1`) | off: KV pool +49.5 %, but KV-KLD 0.028 / top-1 95.0 % against FP8 records (see "KV cache capacity") |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Three-page FP8 packing; scheduler/cache boundaries change, same target records.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0060 | three 64-state kernel pages per manager block for the ratio-1 KV group: 3 × 46,080 B = the ratio-2 block stride, no padding left (`VLLM_DSV41_KV_PAIR=3`, on top of 0057) | **in use:** KV pool 1,346,928 → 1,531,258 tokens (+13.7 %), live 2,187 → 1,827 B per token, cost per round −0.5 %, T=0 identical 8/8, corruption test 0 hits |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Compressed NVFP4 remains above KLD floor and loses accepted tokens; do not alter target quantization.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0061 | FP8 sliding window + NVFP4 compressed KV (as vLLM's SM100 format does): two FlashInfer calls with `return_lse`, merged in Triton (base-2 LSE, sink in the merge) (`VLLM_DSV41_KV_NVFP4=2`) | off: KV pool 1,837,489 with 0060, but KV-KLD 0.0146 / top-1 96.6 % and tok/s −2.8 % (fewer drafts accepted) |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Unmeasured 0.03–0.25% sampling-only estimate; host mask/event sync and async process parked stream need separate design. No positive result justifies port.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0062 | the DSpark verify step's sampling phase on the live rows only: the LM head (where it runs on exl3_mrow), the logits all-gather and the rejection sampler skip the rows past each request's depth, same tokens by construction (`VLLM_DSV41_EXACT_VERIFY=1`; `count` only logs the dead rows per round) | off, not in the image: expected 0.03–0.25 % per round, not measured; a forward of exact width does not fit this stack (see "Tried") |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Measured regression at target verify rows 17–32; competes with routed expert reads. Remote drafter does not fix target bandwidth.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0063 | the dense L2 prefetch also for 17–32-row verify windows (`EXL3_L2PF_MAX_ROWS=32`) | off, not in the image: tok/s −2.2 %, at 4 streams JSON −6.2 % and code −3.0 % |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Target MoE 33–63 row split applies to mixed steps regardless of remote drafter. Changes rounding; affinity must be isolated.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0064 | the routed experts of 33–63-row calls (mixed steps under load, short prompts, last prompt chunks) as exl3_smoe row chunks of ≤ 42 rows, instead of exllamav3's prefill tiers with a host read of the expert counts per layer (`VLLM_EXL3_MOE_SPLIT_MAX_TOKENS=63`) | **in use** (with `EXL3_CPU_PIN`): sustained 118 → 129 tok/s (+9 %), cost per round −0.24 %, corruption test 0 hits; 33–63-row steps round as exl3_smoe does (deterministic) |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: No sustained improvement; 446 MiB extra graphs, breaks memory budget and async graph assumptions.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0065 | mixed prefill + decode steps of up to 32 tokens (40 with the coop limit raised) as breakable PIECEWISE CUDA graphs next to the FULL decode graphs (`cudagraph_mode` FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, `VLLM_DSV41_PW_SIZES`, `VLLM_DSV41_PW_TWINS`, `VLLM_DSV41_PW_MAX_ROWS`) | off, not in the image: sustained +0.0 % after 0064, first token of short arrivals −30 ms, 446 MiB less free on the head node |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Local DSpark fused/trim/prefetch never executes in remote capacity mode; x86host already has its own fused Markov. No SM121 code port to SM86.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0066 | DSpark drafter: each greedy Markov step in three kernels and one all-gather instead of ~13 kernels, same drafts (`VLLM_DSV41_MARKOV_FUSED=1`); the Markov loop only as deep as the next step verifies (`VLLM_DSV41_MARKOV_TRIM=1`); L2 prefetch of the drafter's dense weights (`VLLM_DSV41_DRAFT_L2PF=next`) | `MARKOV_FUSED` **in use** (with 0067: cost per round −0.66 %, T=0 identical); `MARKOV_TRIM` −0.42 % alone but +0.04 % on top of `MARKOV_FUSED`, off; `DRAFT_L2PF` −0.01 %, off |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Target SWA metadata and replay upload remain local; compose model_state with X1 0075, keep no local-drafter changes.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0067 | the eager phase between the drafter graph and the target graph: the decode SWA metadata of all 15 sliding-window groups in one launch instead of 45, the `replay_start` upload only when it changes (`VLLM_DSV41_VOR_FUSED=1`); same bits | **in use**, measured together with 0066's `MARKOV_FUSED` |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Remote depth cap needs remote policy; SO1 selected scheduler pause instead, so do not reintroduce local speculator.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0071 | background verify-depth cap: while a foreground request decodes in the step, requests with `priority` ≥ `VLLM_DSV41_BG_MIN_PRIO` (default 10) verify at most `VLLM_DSV41_BG_DEPTH` drafts, switchable live through the depth file (`bg=`, `bgprio=`); outputs unchanged | **in use** (`VLLM_DSV41_BG_DEPTH=0`): foreground decode next to one / two background streams +29…+56 %, first token unchanged |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Priority-aware background pause adapted to our priority5 floor.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0072 | background decode pause: while a request with `priority` < `VLLM_DSV41_BG_PAUSE_PRIO` runs, the scheduler skips decoding requests at or above it; they keep their KV blocks and drafts and continue once no foreground request runs; prefill chunks stay with 0031; live through the depth file (`bgpause=`); outputs unchanged | **in use** (`VLLM_DSV41_BG_PAUSE_PRIO=10`): foreground decode next to one / two background streams +25…+56 % on top of 0071 `bg=0` (prose 34.4 → 53.8, code 57.5 → 83.2 tok/s next to two), first token unchanged |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Waiting foreground throttle in SO1 scheduler; no duplicate scheduler mount.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0073 | the 0031 prefill throttle also holds while a foreground request (`priority` below `VLLM_PREFILL_THROTTLE_MIN_PRIO`) waits, so the step that admits it carries no background chunk (`VLLM_DSV41_FG_WAIT_THROTTLE=1`) | **in use**, measured together with the 0031 cadence 100000: foreground next to two 60K-token background prefills 22.5 → 56.5 tok/s, first token 3.7–3.8 → 1.3–2.4 s (shares not separated) |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Solo background chunks in SO1 scheduler; compose 0075 hooks before combined test.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0074 | background prefill chunks keep `--long-prefill-token-threshold` also when they are the only eligible request (vLLM drops it then); a foreground request alone still gets the whole budget (`VLLM_DSV41_BG_LPT_SOLO=1`) | **in use**: first token next to one background prefill 2.1–4.0 → 1.4 s; a 60K-token background prompt alone prefills in 112 instead of 92 s |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Use provenance-aware X1 port, never raw donor: remote partial-prefill taps must carry actual suffix length. Scheduler and worker sides inseparable.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0075 | no decoder replay on intermediate prefill chunks: layers 20–39 ran again on each prefilling request's last 128 rows in every step, read by nothing unless the chunk is the last one (`VLLM_DSV41_REPLAY_SKIP=1`) | **in use** (v24): prefill of a 478K-token prompt +4.9 / +5.9 %, 949K tokens +6.5 %; first-token KL against the same image without it 0.0017 (two fresh computes: 0.0015); 26K-token prompts unchanged |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Memory switches/memprobe already carried by K1; preserve all K1 runner bytes.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0076 | head-node memory: no MTP residual buffer for DSpark (`VLLM_DSV41_DROP_MTP_BUFFER=1`), TensorFold prompt scratch per call and aliased (`VLLM_EXL3_TF_PROMPT_TRANSIENT=1`, `VLLM_EXL3_TF_PROMPT_ALIAS=1`), memory probe (`VLLM_DSV41_MEMPROBE`), plus `VLLM_INDEXER_PREFILL_BUFFER_FACTOR=4` | **in use** (v24): +813 MiB free under a 478K-token needle, decode +0.03 %, T=0 identical; this makes 1M fit |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Unused deterministic-prefill tile sidepath; TF_PROMPT=1 bypasses it at >=64 rows, <=63 handled by 0064; association changes without a positive measurement.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: No measured result or adoption claim in README; Dockerfile explicitly excludes 0076c.

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Two-node store/load requires identity/layout and byte-equality gates; independent of remote draft wire state.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0077 | KV offload with TP across two nodes: one copy per chunk (every offloaded layer is one latent head, identical on both ranks: the two CPU tiers were byte-identical after the same stores), rank 0 stores, before each load the chunks go from rank 0's CPU tier to rank 1's over a gloo group (`VLLM_DSV41_OFFLOAD_MULTINODE=1`) | **in use** (v24): 75K-token prefixes from the file tier after a restart in 1.3–2.1 s instead of 33.8 s, first-token KL 0.0003–0.0035 against a fresh compute, decode +0.27 % |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: S17: ungated C++ changes, hint-timeout escalation and row-split overhead. X1 code retained unmounted for reference only; no arm or new Engram JIT.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0078 | Engram reads in prefill: lookahead reader for the next chunk's rows (`VLLM_DSV41_ENGRAM_LOOKAHEAD=4096`), reader pool CPUs (`VLLM_DSV41_ENGRAM_POOL_CPUS`) | lookahead **in use** (v24): prefill +9.4 % (131K tokens of new text), +8.3 % (32K repeated), decode −0.04 %; the pool on the A725 cores slows every decode round by 0.6–1.1 %: off |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Target mechanisms apply but measured within noise; cache lifetime/aliasing and K1 flashinfer composition risk without gain.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0079 | decode fixed costs: global top-k indices reused across layers with the same inputs, no zero output for the shared expert (`VLLM_DSV41_GTOPK_REUSE=1`, `VLLM_EXL3_MOE_SHARED_ZEROS=1`) | off: decode −0.32 % (noise ±0.6 %), the estimated 0.35–0.6 % not measurable |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Dummy full-context startup reservation reduced lowest free memory by 280 MiB; remote parked streams add warmup hazards.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0080 | reserve the late memory peaks at startup (dummy prefill at full context, mixed step, vision encoder; `VLLM_DSV41_PREALLOC=1`) | off: the floor does not become flat; lowest free memory under a 949K-token needle 1,970 instead of 2,250 MiB |

patches.our_applicability_and_conflicts: Load cap/I/O affinity; RP1 handles connector and headroom tests.
patches.upstream_readme_verbatim: | 0081 | KV offload: per-request load cap from the CPU tier size (a prefix needing more chunks than the CPU tier holds evicted its own promoted chunks and waited forever) and the file tier's I/O threads off the decode cores (`VLLM_DSV41_OFFLOAD_LOAD_FRACTION=0.45`, `VLLM_DSV41_OFFLOAD_IO_CPUS=0-4,10-13`) | **in use** (v24): with a 256 MiB CPU tier (~148K tokens) at most 66,432 tokens per request come from the file tier; a 252K-token prefix: 84.3 s instead of 111.2 s, no hang |
